content: Dolohape Yida Asata
Kawa Herodiisa woden Yesuusi Yihuda biittan Beeteleme kataman yeletidaape guye xoolinto taybiya asati dolohape Yerusalaame yidi,
“Yeletida Ayhude kawoy awun de7ii? Nuuni doloha baggara keyida iya xoolintuwa be7idi iyaw goyinnanaw yida” yaagidi oychidosona.
Kawoy Herodiisi hessa si7ida wode dagammis. Yerusalaamen de7iya asa ubbayka dagammidosona.
Herodiisi kahine halaqatanne higge astamaareta baako xeegidi, “Kiristoosi awun yeletandesha?” yaagidi enta oychis.
Entika, “Yihuda Beetelemena; nabey,
yaagidosona.
Hessafe guye, Herodiisi dolohape yida asata geeman xeegidi, xoolintuwa enti be7ida wodiya entafe geeshshidi eris.
I entana Beeteleme yeddishe, “Bidi yeletida na7aa minthidi koyite; iya hinte demmida wode taka bada iyaw goyinnana mela simmidi yishe taw odite” yaagis.
Entika kawoy Herodiisi gidaysa si7idi bidosona. Enti doloha baggara be7ida xoolintoy entana kaalethishe na7ay de7iyasuwa gakanaw efis.
Enti he xoolintuwa be7ida wode gita ufaysi ufaytidosona.
Soo gelidi na7aa ba aaye Mayraamira de7eysa be7idosona. Iyaw gulbatidi goyinnidosona. Banta saaxiniya dooyidi worqa, ixaanenne karbe iyaw immidosona.
Enti Herodiisako guye simmonna mela Xoossay amuhon entaw odin, hara ogera banta biitta simmidosona.
Gibxe Baqato

Doloha baggafe yida asati bidaape guye, Godaa kiitanchoy Yoosefas amuhon qoncidi, “Herodiisi na7aa wodhanaw koyiya gisho denda; ellesada na7aanne na7aa aayiw ekada Gibxe biitta ba. Ne simmana wodiya ta new odana gakanaw yan gam7a” yaagis.
Hessa gisho, Yoosefi he qamman dendidi, na7aanne na7aa aayiw ekidi Gibxe bis.
Nabiya doonan Xoossay, “Taani, ta na7aa, Gibxe biittafe xeegas” geetetida qaalay poletana mela Herodiisi hayqana gakanaw I yan de7is.

Hessafe guye, doloha baggafe yida asati iya cimmidaysa erida wode daro yilotis. I kase entafe si7idaysada Beetelemeninne he heeran de7iya nam7u laythi kumidaysatanne nam7u laythafe garsan de7iya adde nayta ubbaa ba wotaadareta yeddidi wodhisis.
Nabiya Ermiyaasa doonan,
gidi odidaysi poletis.
Naazirete Simuwa
Herodiisi hayqidaape guye Gibxen Godaa kiitanchoy Yoosefas amuhon qoncidi,
“Na7aa wodhanaw koyiya asati hayqida gisho, dendada na7aanne na7aa aayiw ekada Isra7eele biitta simma” yaagis.
Yoosefi dendidi na7aanne na7aa aayiw ekidi Isra7eele biitta simmis.
Shin Arkeliyoosi Yihudan ba aawa Herodiisa bessan kawotidaysa si7ida wode yaa baanaw yayyis. Xoossay amuhon iyaw qoncisin Galila biitta bis.
Nabeta doonan, “Naazirete asi geetetana” gidi odetidaysi poletana mela Naazirete katamaa bidi yan de7is.
